# Copilot instructions for Pausa

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for the project rules and commands, and [`HANDOFF.md`](../HANDOFF.md)
for current status, pitfalls and next steps (App Store review state, store-build gotchas, Windows
signing). Detailed docs: [`appstore/README.md`](../appstore/README.md) and
[`windows/README.md`](../windows/README.md).

Never commit credentials, and don't change anything in App Store Connect without the maintainer's
explicit approval.
